name: Forget It!
source:
Please help the two classmates remember what happened yesterday.

Why is the police officer looking for them?

Where did he hid the item?

[From [url=https://purple-bear.itch.io/forget-it]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
請幫助兩名同班同學想起昨天發生了什麼。

警察為什麼在找他們？
那個東西被他藏在哪裡了？[引自[url=https://purple-bear.itch.io/forget-it]Itch.io[/url]]
